entities.name: Marie Clémence Lesson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marie Clémence Lesson was an illustrator and the second wife of French ornithologist René Lesson, who she married in 1827. She trained as a natural history artist in Paris and her illustrations appear in her husband's book Histoire Naturelle des Oiseaux-Mouches. Her father was the French zoologist Charles Dumont de Sainte-Croix. Lesson died of Cholera in 1834.
